'''bmackin13 DBOPS''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bmackin13]]
* '''Published:''' 17 August 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif|label=Dantooine Base Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dantooine Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 DBO bmackin13 LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), They're On Dantooine (V), Tawss Khaa (V), Romas "Lock" Navander (V), Bionic Hand (V), Mercenary Armor (V), Civil Disorder (V), Bright Hope (V), Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

DBOPS based losely on starfighters/matching piolts.

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Set 1); They're On Dantooine (V) (Virtual Set 3); Romas "Lock" Navander (V) (Virtual Set 4); Bionic Hand (V), Civil Disorder (V), Bright Hope (V) (Virtual Set 6); Tawss Khaa (V), Mercenary Armor (V) (Virtual Set 7).
* Posted 'There On Dantooine(v)' dested They're On Dantooine (V).
* Posted 'BoShek(v)' has no original-era (V) printing legal by 2004-08-17 (ovs_pick returns none), so the printed BoShek is used.

== Strategy ==

I have never played this before and need some major help for strategy.

I'll explain some of my choices:

Bravo 2 + Dolphe - Deploy for 3, power 4, draws a battle destiny, opponent's BD's are - 2

Gold 3 + Torsyn - Deploy 3, power 4, retrieve a force when deployed to Dantooine, force drain +1 at dantooine, and destiny to total power

Romas "Lock" Navander - pulls systems while at Spaceport DB

Kiffex - Good generation and drain

Kessel - real good drain

i am working on getting Queen's Royal Starship so Ric will go on there.

keep in mind, i only have one personna of most of the characters, except han.  i have almost every han.
